description_en: Queries the properties of a configuration list
description_zh: 获取配置清单的模式信息
kebab_example: aliyun oos get-inventory-schema --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --aggregator false --type-name ACS:Application --max-results 50 --next-token gAAAAABfh8MVLQI9AuKGACLgjbsXbWs-Mna47IDM6tr6wK7TZ1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetInventorySchema

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return only properties that support the aggregate feature in the configuration list. Valid values:

true: only returns properties that support the aggregate feature in the configuration list.
false: returns all properties in the configuration list
parameters.help_zh:
是否仅展示支持聚合的模式。
取值范围：
true（只返回支持聚合的模式）
false（返回所有的模式）
parameters.name: aggregator

parameters.help_en:
The configuration list type name. Valid values:

ACS:InstanceInformation
ACS:Application
ACS:File
ACS:Network
ACS:WindowsRole
ACS:Service
ACS:WindowsUpdate
ACS:WindowsRegistry
parameters.help_zh:
组件名称。取值范围：
ACS:InstanceInformation
ACS:Application
ACS:File
ACS:Network
ACS:WindowsRole
ACS:Service
ACS:WindowsUpdate
ACS:WindowsRegistry
parameters.name: type_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。取值范围：1-100。默认为50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
parameters.name: next_token
